canonicalLine: Floor plans as code. Your AI writes ArchLang; the compiler draws a precise, dimensioned plan and tells it what's wrong.

claudeai.label: claude.ai connector
claudeai.note: no install; add as a custom connector

agent.label: Your coding agent
agent.claudeCodeHttp: claude mcp add --transport http archlang https://mcp.archlang.uk/mcp

agentPrompt: 2. Run: npx -y @chanmeng666/archlang spec   (read it before writing anything)
3. Write my floor plan as plan.arch from this brief: <describe rooms, areas, adjacencies>
then describe plan.arch --json, validate plan.arch --strict --json (same prefix); fix, recompile
5. Run: npx -y @chanmeng666/archlang finish plan.arch, then compile again to export.
Starting from a photo or PDF? Read https://archlang.uk/from-an-image. To change one room without moving the others, use `impact --lock` (https://archlang.uk/edit-one-room).
